decisions.reason: While the firm has strong lighting know-how, submarine interiors are a narrower adjacent niche and the product had weaker visible commitment than the others, so management would likely redeploy resources rather than continue learning on a less related application.

Industrial explosion-proof luminaires are very close to the firm's existing technical base, and the 2019 LED replacement kit indicates active learning and improvement that supports continued commercialization.
As a relaunch of a previously popular designer task light, it builds on knowledge the firm already possesses and can refine without needing a major leap beyond its established capabilities.

A pendant office luminaire fits closely with the firm's established lighting competences, so a large incumbent with in-house development capacity would usually keep it and iterate rather than exit quickly.

The premium pendant luminaire remains technically close to the firm's core knowledge, although its more design-led premium positioning makes it somewhat more vulnerable if market feedback has been only moderate.
